messages:
sarah.le: Heads up — prod-us-east-1: some pods can't reach our telemetry ingestion service via the PrivateLink endpoint. DNS resolves to the VPCE IPs but TCP SYNs get RSTs. Anyone seen this pattern before? @mike.kim @jia.li

mike.kim: ugh. do we have packet captures? which subnets/AZs are affected?

jia.li: saw a customer hit similar last month — often route table funny business or endpoint SGs. can you paste `dig` + `tcpdump` snippets?

sarah.le: quick bits below. DNS -> vpce-abcdef123.us-east-1.vpce.amazonaws.com -> CNAMEs -> 10.0.5.123,10.0.6.45

sarah.le: tcpdump from node (tcp port 443):
```
05:12:33 IP 10.244.1.12.52344 > 10.0.5.123.443: Flags [S], seq 0, win 64240, options [mss 1460], length 0
05:12:33 IP 10.0.5.123.443 > 10.244.1.12.52344: Flags [R], seq 1, win 0, length 0
```

eric.h: RST from the endpoint ENI IP usually means the endpoint rejected the connection — could be SG or source IP mismatch. run `aws ec2 describe-route-tables` for the subnet route tables.

rachel.p: also check for any explicit /32 host routes. saw a terraform hack that added /32 to force traffic via an EIP for testing — that SNATs things and confuses endpoint SGs.

mike.kim: i pulled the route tables for the affected subnets. snippet: 
```
"Routes": [
  { "DestinationCidrBlock": "10.0.5.123/32", "GatewayId": "igw-0abc", "State": "active" },
  { "DestinationCidrBlock": "0.0.0.0/0", "GatewayId": "nat-0fff", "State": "active" },
  { "DestinationCidrBlock": "10.0.0.0/16", "GatewayId": "local", "State": "active" }
]
```

mike.kim: there it is — a /32 route for the VPCE IP pointing at the IGW (was originally an EIP proxy route during a test). that will send pod traffic out to the internet EIP and get SNATed. the PrivateLink SG sees the EIP as source and drops it -> RST.

jia.li: nice catch. quick fix = remove the /32 route so routing returns to local (VPC). also validate endpoint SG allows the worker node SG (or VPC CIDR).

sarah.le: removing the /32 route now. Ran: `aws ec2 delete-route --route-table-id rtb-0aa --destination-cidr-block 10.0.5.123/32`

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-5913 — privatelink connectivity in prod-us-east-1 — pager oncall team notified.

sarah.le: after deleting the route: tcpdump shows SYN -> SYN/ACK from 10.0.5.123, TLS handshake starts. pods recovering. thanks all. :tada:

eric.h: follow-up action: add a short-runbook note to avoid temp host routes for VPCE ENIs and require PR approval. also check terraform modules for any `proxy_eip` toggles.

rachel.p: i'll open a tiny GHPR to add a lint rule that flags /32 routes pointing to IGW/NAT for addresses inside the VPC range.

mike.kim: also double-check ENI limits — if folks were creating lots of manual host routes earlier we might have leftover garbage in other subnets. running a sweep next hour.

sarah.le: thanks team. closing thread once the postmortem note is in INC-2026-5913.
